## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to diagnose container CPU throttling using native Linux controls, mapping processes to containers, and applying safe quota changes with observability.

## Key Concepts
- Linux cgroups CPU controller: cpu.cfs_quota_us, cpu.cfs_period_us
- Mapping processes to containers via /proc/<pid>/cgroup
- cpuset for CPU isolation
- Safe observability during reconfiguration

## Code Example
```javascript

ps -eo pid,pcpu,cmd --sort=-pcpu | head -n 8
for pid in $(ps -eo pid --sort=-pcpu | head -n 6); do echo PID=$pid; awk -F: '{print $3}' /proc/$pid/cgroup; done
for cg in docker-*.scope; do echo $cg; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/$cg/cpu.cfs_quota_us; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/$cg/cpu.cfs_period_us; done
```
